notes.IDLE: State: SYS_IDLE Entry function: enter_idle() Do action: do_action() periodic checks Subsystems: [[power_fsm_diagram_with_api.html power_fsm]] (low battery management), [[comm_fsm_diagram_with_api.html comm_fsm]] (network monitoring) Main operational state
notes.RECORDING: State: SYS_RECORDING Entry function: enter_recording() Do action: monitor recording progress Subsystems: [[recording_fsm_diagram_with_api.html recording_fsm]], [[audio_fsm_diagram_with_api.html audio_fsm]] active
notes.REC_UPL: State: SYS_RECORDING_AND_UPLOADING Entry function: enter_recording_and_uploading() Do action: monitor recording & streaming Subsystems: [[recording_fsm_diagram_with_api.html recording_fsm]], [[audio_fsm_diagram_with_api.html audio_fsm]], [[comm_fsm_diagram_with_api.html comm_fsm]] active
notes.UPLOADING: State: SYS_UPLOADING Entry function: enter_uploading() Do action: upload to cloud Subsystems: [[comm_fsm_diagram_with_api.html comm_fsm]] active
notes.ERROR: State: SYS_ERROR Entry function: enter_error() Error handling: error_code, error_msg Recovery: Reset or shutdown
notes.OTA: State: SYS_OTA Entry function: enter_ota() Do action: download & install update Subsystems: [[ota_fsm_diagram_with_api.html ota_fsm]] active Transitions: From IDLE (OTA_START), From INIT (pending update) Exit events: OTA_COMPLETE, OTA_CANCEL, OTA_ERROR, POWER_OFF
notes.SLEEP: State: SYS_SLEEP Entry function: enter_sleep() Do action: low‑power sleep Subsystems: [[power_fsm_diagram_with_api.html power_fsm]] (sleep mode) Wake‑up events: POWER_ON, LOW_BATTERY
notes.SHUTDOWN: State: SYS_SHUTDOWN Entry function: (none) Do action: power off sequence Final state: No outgoing transitions API: system_coordinator_dispatch_event(sys, SYS_EVT_POWER_OFF, NULL)
notes.RESET: State: SYS_RESET Entry function: enter_reset() Do action: reset subsystems Auto transition: to INIT after reset complete API: system_coordinator_dispatch_event(sys, SYS_EVT_RESET, NULL)
